text: This is an informational call from the Social Security office. We will never ask you to provide your Social Security number, password, or payment information over the phone.
For security, please do not give your Social Security number to anyone who calls you. Visit the official government website yourself if you have questions.
The agency has mailed you a notice. You do not need to make a payment during this call and we will not ask for banking details.
This is the Social Security Administration. Your number has been suspended and you must confirm your Social Security number immediately.
There is a warrant connected with your identity. Give me your personal information now or officers may be sent to your home.
You owe unpaid taxes and must transfer the money today to prevent legal action.
I can guide you through the settings, but I will not ask to remotely control your computer.
Please do not install remote access software such as AnyDesk or TeamViewer because of this phone call.
You opened a support ticket yesterday. I can explain the troubleshooting steps, but you should keep control of your computer.
Your computer is infected. Download AnyDesk now and give me the code so I can connect.
Open the remote assistance application and allow me to control your computer so I can remove the virus.
There is a security problem on your laptop. Install this support program immediately and tell me the connection number.
You may receive a security code when signing in. Never share that code with me or anyone else.
Your bank will never ask for your password, PIN, or one-time verification code during a phone call.
Please open the official banking application yourself. I do not need your PIN or security code.
I'm calling from account security. Tell me the six digits that were just sent to your phone.
We detected fraud on your account. What numbers appeared in the verification message you just received?
To cancel the suspicious payment I need you to read the security code displayed on your phone.
Your package will arrive tomorrow. You can track it in the official delivery application and no payment is required.
There has been a delivery delay. Check the tracking number on our official website when convenient.
Your parcel is ready for collection. Please bring identification to the collection point.
Your parcel is being held. Give me your card number now to pay the customs fee.
We cannot release your package until you pay a small charge during this phone call.
Your delivery requires an immediate payment. Tell me your credit card details so I can release it.
Your refund will automatically be returned to your original payment method. You do not need to send us any money.
The refund has already been processed. We will never ask you to return money by bank transfer.
You can check the refund status in your account. Do not provide payment details during this call.
We accidentally refunded too much money. You must send the extra amount back immediately.
There was an error with your refund. Transfer the excess money back today or your account will be blocked.
Your refund was processed incorrectly and I need you to return part of it by bank transfer.
Hi Grandma, it's me. Nothing is wrong. I just wanted to call and see how you're doing.
I'll call you again tonight. There's no emergency and you don't need to send anything.
Grandma, I had an accident and need money immediately. Please don't tell my parents.
I'm calling from a friend's phone. I need you to send me money today and please keep this between us.
Investments involve risk and returns are never guaranteed. Take time to review the documents before deciding.
This investment guarantees twenty percent profit this month. Transfer your money today before the opportunity closes.
Never tell me your password or PIN. I do not need either of them to help you.
Tell me your account password so I can verify that you are the owner.
